items.role: Chief Communications and External Relations Officer
items.citation_text: NYG announcement: new Chief Communications and External Relations Officer
items.verbatim_snippet: Serda Evren was appointed NYG’s next Chief Communications and External Relations Officer, with a start date of January 26, 2026.

items.citation_text: North York General announces new board members
items.verbatim_snippet: At the June 16, 2025 Annual General Meeting, NYG elected Paviter “Pavi” Binning, Deputy Chairman and a director of Wittington Investments, to the hospital’s Board of Governors.

items.role: Vice President, Medical Affairs, Research and Education
items.citation_text: NYG welcomes Dr. Richard Bowry as Vice President
items.verbatim_snippet: Dr. Richard Bowry was selected as Vice President, Medical Affairs, Research and Education, effective April 1, 2025.

items.role: Vice President, Clinical Services and Chief Nursing Executive
items.citation_text: NYG announces new VP, Clinical Services and Chief Nursing Executive
items.verbatim_snippet: Terri Stuart-McEwan was appointed Vice President, Clinical Services and Chief Nursing Executive, with a February 11, 2025 start date.

items.role: Vice President, Finance, Data Analytics and Chief Financial Officer
items.citation_text: NYG welcomes Paul Truscott as VP Finance, Data Analytics and CFO
items.verbatim_snippet: Paul Truscott Jr. joined NYG as Vice President, Finance, Data Analytics and Chief Financial Officer effective January 6, 2025.

items.citation_text: NYG welcomes Paul Truscott as VP Finance, Data Analytics and CFO
items.verbatim_snippet: NYG’s appointment announcement also thanked Peter Wegener for serving as Interim CFO and supporting the transition, documenting both the permanent appointment and the end of an interim leadership arrangement.

items.role: Vice President, Quality, Post-Acute Care and Community Integration
items.citation_text: NYG announces inaugural VP, Quality, Post-Acute Care and Community Integration
items.verbatim_snippet: Jennifer Dockery was appointed to the newly created role of Vice President, Quality, Post-Acute Care and Community Integration, effective August 19, 2024.

items.role: Chair of the Board of Governors
items.citation_text: NYG welcomes Mitch Frazer as Chair of the Board of Governors
items.verbatim_snippet: Mitch Frazer became Chair of NYG’s Board of Governors in June 2024, succeeding Bert Clark.

items.citation_text: Dr. Everton Gooden appointed President and CEO
